title: auth: CredentialStore missing Clone derive — cannot be used without Arc indirection
description: crates/auth/src/store.rs: CredentialStore derives only Debug. The type contains only HashMap<String,String> and String, both of which are Clone. All callers wrap it in Arc<CredentialStore> immediately, which is appropriate for shared use. However, not deriving Clone means it cannot be passed by value without Arc in simpler contexts.
notes: Low urgency: the Arc pattern is correct for the production server case. Counterargument for not deriving Clone: a credential store that holds many bcrypt hashes is expensive to copy; forcing Arc is intentional and protective. Recommend an explicit decision comment on the struct.
